use_rule: Definitions are design-stage proposals for official confirmation. Unknown values must remain null until every activation condition is met.

indicators.formula: sum(normalized_dimension_score * approved_dimension_weight) across research, enterprise, talent, testing, technology-transfer, and public service dimensions
indicators.reason: No officially adopted local baseline, weights, reporting year, or verified input series is available.
indicators.activation_condition: The competent authority approves the indicator dimensions, weights, reporting year, study boundary, and auditable input series.

indicators.formula: verified full-time AI R&D and technical-service personnel / verified AI industry and research gross floor area in hectares
indicators.reason: Employer-level aggregate personnel counts and verified AI-space floor areas are unavailable.
indicators.measurement_unit: persons per hectare of verified AI industry and research floor area
indicators.activation_condition: Use aggregated, non-personal employer records for one reporting year and a verified floor-area inventory within the same boundary.

indicators.formula: sum(audited annual operating revenue or officially defined output value of eligible AI entities within the study boundary), with duplicate legal entities removed
indicators.reason: An official statistical definition, reporting-year enterprise roster, and auditable financial or statistical series are unavailable.
indicators.activation_condition: The statistics authority confirms the output definition, eligible entity roster, boundary, reporting year, and de-duplication rule.

indicators.formula: count(distinct verified active AI enterprises with an operating site inside the official boundary) / official study area in square kilometres
indicators.reason: A verified, de-duplicated enterprise roster and official study polygon are unavailable.
indicators.measurement_unit: active AI enterprises per square kilometre
indicators.activation_condition: Confirm the AI-enterprise eligibility rule, active status, operating address, reporting date, and official polygon.

indicators.formula: sum(verified gross floor area assigned to eligible AI research, testing, incubation, enterprise service, and supporting production uses)
indicators.reason: No building-level existing-use survey, tenancy roster, ownership record, or verified gross-floor-area dataset is available.
indicators.activation_condition: Complete a building and tenancy inventory with surveyed floor area, use, vacancy, rights, and operating status.

indicators.reason: Both the eligible AI-space area and regional total building floor area are unavailable.
indicators.activation_condition: Activate only after both numerator and denominator use the same official boundary, survey date, and gross-floor-area convention.

indicators.formula: sum(verified existing gross floor area within the official overall-design boundary)
indicators.reason: Existing-building survey, approved floor-area records, and the official overall-design polygon are unavailable.
indicators.activation_condition: Reconcile survey, planning-permit, completion-acceptance, and building-register records against the official polygon.

indicators.formula: sum(parcel or building areas classified through verified retain, repair, adapt, replace, or public-realm-improvement screening)
indicators.reason: Building condition, use efficiency, vacancy, ownership, heritage, infrastructure capacity, and regulatory constraints are unavailable at parcel level.
indicators.activation_condition: Complete site survey and multi-department verification before assigning any parcel or building to a renewal class.

indicators.formula: 100 * count(accessibly reachable categories among work, housing, daily service, learning, and recreation) / 5, assessed by verified walking network and agreed time threshold
indicators.reason: A verified facility inventory, accessible walking network, residential and employment data, and an approved travel-time threshold are unavailable.
indicators.activation_condition: Agree the five-category facility standard and travel-time threshold, then validate facilities, entrances, opening hours, capacity, and accessible routes.
